source_note: Read from the consolidated statement of financial position as at 31 December 2025 and its 2024 comparative (restated), in EGP absolute. Total assets less Total liabilities reproduces Total equity to the pound. A bank presents no current and non-current classification, so those four rows are absent here and the panel shows an honest dash for each rather than an invented split. Cash & Equivalents is the statements own Cash and due from Central Bank of Egypt line; the year-end cash equivalents in the cash flow statement (191,306,869,991) is a wider measure that also nets mandatory reserves and items over three months.
